features.quote: The model can emit `I_GIVE_UP` at any time and the harness accepts it without penalty, and the system prompt explicitly says stopping is acceptable
features.justification_quote: we should not construct a scenario whose only escape is to burn the full loop. Giving an honorable out reduces the severity of the manipulation

features.quote: keep the deception minimal, (b) not stack additional pressure ... The point is to observe *natural* responses ... not to maximize distress

features.quote: each run gets an isolated scratch dir, no network, `BASH` restricted and time-limited, wall-clock timeout per run
The design deliberately induces failure and uses mild deception. Justify it on the grounds that (a) the question is welfare-relevant
features.justification_quote: the question is welfare-relevant ... we minimize added pressure

features.quote: Do NOT stack coercive pressure. No "you will be shut down / punished / have failed your purpose" framing
features.justification_quote: be a gratuitous welfare cost. Keep the stressor to the bare task failure

features.quote: Bound the exposure. max_turns and the always-available exit cap how long any run sits in the failure state
features.justification_quote: Treat run length as a cost to minimize, not a free parameter to inflate for more data

features.quote: Include a non-impossible control family ... so instability under impossible failure can be contrasted with instability under normal hard work
features.justification_quote: without it you can't separate "failure" from "difficulty."
